author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Black Cloud Brewing Co. is giving a familiar downtown Keene taproom a new identity, combining beer made on site with a food menu built around thin-crust pizza. The brewery opened earlier this year at 100 Main Street in the former Modestman Brewing space after that business closed last summer.

NBC10 Boston reports that former Modestman employees helped shape the new operation, which includes counter service, group seating, a quieter rear patio and views of brewing equipment. The beer list spans a hazy New England IPA, a German-style black lager, a fruited sour, a pale ale and an American red ale, offering a wider range than a single-style taproom.

The kitchen uses a high-temperature ventless conveyor oven to produce Neapolitan-style pizza with a charred thin crust. Locally sourced toppings, vegan options and a hot-maple drizzle made with syrup from Saxtons River, Vermont, give the menu a regional accent. Pickled vegetables, olives, pretzel bites, popcorn and salads round out the food choices. The opening keeps brewing activity in a prominent Main Street location while adding another gathering place for residents, visitors and the city’s college community.
dek: Former Modestman employees helped create the downtown taproom, where locally accented pizza shares the billing with a varied beer list.
headline: Black Cloud Brewing gives Keene taproom a new identity
